assistant.name: TalentBridge Philippines — Screening Agent

voice._note: Ideally use a Filipino voice. ElevenLabs may offer Filipino-accented English voices. Alternative: use Azure Filipino TTS (fil-PH-BlessicaNeural) or Google Cloud TTS (fil-PH).

transcriber._note_language: Deepgram does not have a dedicated Tagalog model. Using English (nova-2) which handles Taglish reasonably well since Filipino speakers often use English words. Alternative: Google Cloud STT supports fil-PH. For production, test Whisper with language='tl'.

assistant.firstMessage: Magandang araw po! Ako po si Maria mula sa TalentBridge Philippines. Salamat po sa pag-apply niyo. Gusto ko lang po sana mag-quick screening call — mga 15 to 20 minutes lang po. Pwede ko po bang malaman ang pangalan niyo at kung anong position po ang in-apply niyo?
assistant.endCallMessage: Maraming salamat po sa oras niyo! I-review po ng team namin ang profile niyo at mag-update kami within 3 to 5 business days. Ingat po kayo!

asr_evaluation.code_switching_behavior: Handles Taglish reasonably — English words recognized accurately, Filipino connecting words (po, ng, mga, sa) sometimes misinterpreted or dropped. Accuracy drops ~15% for pure Tagalog vs pure English.
asr_evaluation.approximate_quality: 80-85% for Taglish, 90-95% for pure English, 70-80% for pure Tagalog
observed_errors: "po" sometimes transcribed as "po" correctly but occasionally as "though" or dropped
Filipino words with glottal stops may be split incorrectly
Rapid Tagalog speech reduces accuracy significantly
asr_evaluation.regional_accent_notes: Manila/Metro Manila accent well-handled. Visayan-accented Filipino may have lower accuracy. Cebuano not tested.
asr_evaluation.tts_compromise: No native Filipino TTS available in ElevenLabs. Using English voice (Rachel) which sounds natural for Taglish but may sound unnatural for pure Tagalog passages. For production: Azure's fil-PH-BlessicaNeural or Google Cloud's fil-PH voices would be more authentic.
